searchText: What are the best resources for era files? I saw only in nimbus. We'd love to move towards a state expiry world with some ability to revive it. Maybe post verkle? era does not address state growth, only history to do that, step one is to finalize and ship the era1 format (more here https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/26621). then we need to add support for importing standard era files into EL clients.
